description:
## **Hack With GDG S4**
**36 Hours of Innovation, Building, and Impact!**

Welcome to the fourth season of **Hack With GDG**, a high-energy hackathon hosted by **Google Developer Groups - KSR College of Engineering (GDG KSRCE)**. After three massive seasons, we are back to push the boundaries of creativity and technology.

**Event Timeline**
**Round 1 (Ideation)**: Submit your project idea in PPT format.
**Deadline**: Sep 28, 2026
**Round 2 (The Hack)**: 36-Hour Offline Hackathon.
**Dates**: Oct 8 - 10, 2026
**Venue**: KSR College of Engineering, Namakkal, Tamil Nadu.
**What’s Happening?**
**Round 1: Selection Phase**
Submit your vision. While a prototype is a plus, we are looking for strong problem-solving ideas. Top teams move to the grand finale.

**Round 2: 36-Hour Offline Grind**
This is where the magic happens. Build your full prototype on-site.

**Side Events**: Fun activities to keep the energy high.
**Mentorship**: Industry experts to guide your build.
**Networking**: Connect with fellow techies and developers.

**Rewards & Perks**
Cash Prizes for the top winning teams.
Participation Certificates for all attendees.

**Who Can Join?**
Whether you are a **Beginner** or a **Pro**, there is a place for you!

**Developers**: Build the future.
**Designers**: Create stunning UI/UX.
**Innovators**: Pitch unique solutions to real-world problems.
**Team Size**: 1 – 4 Members.
**Meals & Refreshments included for participants**
**Contact & Support**
Got questions? Reach out to us:

Email: gdgksrce@gmail.com
Instagram: [@gdg_ksrce](https://www.instagram.com/gdg_ksrce?igsi=YTBoZ3ZsNngxbXR5)
